fatalErrors: [ACCP_MISSING_LIVE_EVIDENCE] NEG-010 negative control: missing_live_evidence. P49 Tab/mode-picker is a user-visible TUI requirement. scripts/p0-tui-smoke.mjs launches the real TUI editor in a VirtualTerminal (backed by @xterm/headless), sends a real Tab keypress, and captures the screen. The live observation shows the screen does NOT contain the accp-mode-picker overlay: the picker module exists but is not wired to the editor's Tab handler. Promotion must be blocked because the user-visible behavior is contradicted by live evidence.
